mapper.sql: select l.log_id, l.log_code, l.courtyard_id, c.courtyard_name, l.address_id, l.address_name, l.main_type, l.sub_type, l.inspect_result, l.hazard_level, l.description, l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone, l.inspect_time, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark from ins_log l left join ins_courtyard c on l.courtyard_id = c.courtyard_id
mapper.insert: insert into ins_log(log_code, courtyard_id, address_id, address_name, main_type, sub_type, inspect_result, hazard_level, description, tenant_name, tenant_phone, inspect_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{logCode}, #{courtyardId}, #{addressId}, #{addressName}, #{mainType}, #{subType}, #{inspectResult}, #{hazardLevel}, #{description}, #{tenantName}, #{tenantPhone}, #{inspectTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
